notes.title: Box Wrangler Past, Present, and Future
notes.content:
Box Wrangler is my first game and started out as a side project to learn how to make games in February 2024. Thank you to everyone who has tried it so far.

Why is this game called Box Wrangler?
Initially it began as a puzzle game where you controlled multiple boxes at one time to navigate from point A to point B while avoiding obstacles.

But Why Boxes?
I don't have to animate arms and legs on boxes and I think it's funny to have my main character be a dirty little trashcan.

Refining The Experience
There are some bugs to squash and UI interactions to optimize in the coming weeks. Please reach out if you have any needs for accessibility settings!
       - Steam Multiplayer games might not currently work with more than 2 people
       - Sometimes the AK-47 becomes unstable in multiplayer games
https://i.imgur.com/25xsQUq.gif


Future Map, Guns, Characters, and Powers
In the Coming Months Box Wrangler will continue to receive updates bringing new playable maps, unlock-able weapons, and powers. 
     -Cave Map With Shadow Enemies
     -Power purchasing improved bullet spread
     -Freeze Ray
     -Customizable/Unlock-able Box Skins
     -Black Jack

If you have any particular desire for a certain feature please let me know!
